g.text: The Aperture: Blast Radius Decides Inclusion
Every decision has a blast radius. Wide-radius decisions enter the graph; locally contained ones stay out.
Stays in code or conﬁg. Local autonomy.
Nothing enters the graph without a positive reason to include it.
If this element changes, how many other things in other parts of the system have to change?
Many things across teams or layers
Elements that should have been included will surface when their changes start cascading without graph governance.
